verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI supports LLM-based structured extraction and even a CLI query mode (`crwl ... -q "Extract all product prices"`) that lets users specify extraction goals in natural language rather than writing CSS/XPath selectors, backed by cosine-similarity/semantic chunk retrieval for query-driven extraction. missing for 10: independent hands-on evidence of extraction accuracy/quality for natural-language-specified schemas, and detailed docs on how NL instructions map to structured JSON output (schema inference reliability).
